description: This file defines a generic interface for a grain in Orleans, specifying asynchronous methods for setting, transforming, getting, and comparing grain data.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of type T in the grain.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Performs an internal transformation on the grain data.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of type T from the grain.
